parts.script:
Tom: Hey Sarah, have you thought about our weekend trip to the mountains? 
Sarah: Yes! I was thinking we could leave early Saturday morning. 
Tom: That sounds great. What time do you want to leave? 
Sarah: How about 7 AM? It should give us plenty of time to hike before it gets dark. 
Tom: That works. Should we take my car or do you want to use yours? 
Sarah: Let’s take yours; it has more space for our gear. 
Tom: Good idea! Do we need to pack anything special? 
Sarah: Yes, we should bring extra water and snacks. Also, don’t forget the first aid kit. 
Tom: Right. I’ll pack that tonight. What about the weather? 
Sarah: I checked, and it looks sunny all weekend. Just a bit chilly at night. 
Tom: Perfect! I'll also bring a warm jacket for the evenings. 
Sarah: Sounds like a plan! I can't wait to get out in nature.  
Tom: Me too! It will be a nice break from the city.
